subject.title: docs: record mobile KMP feasibility gates

question: Should OpenClaw publish this specific KMP/SKIE experiment contract and net-negative merge gate as future mobile direction before an implementation sponsor exists?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent, but code and docs checks cannot authorize a durable dependency, ownership, and contribution-policy direction that the paired issue still describes as awaiting Android and Apple sponsorship.

options.title: Owner-sponsor the full plan
options.body: Have Android and Apple owners review, correct, and explicitly sponsor the current document before merge.

options.title: Publish only verified constraints
options.body: Retain the demonstrated package failure and native ownership boundaries while removing unsponsored dependency, module-layout, and rollout choices.

options.title: Defer public documentation
options.body: Keep the paired issue open and revisit a public plan with an owner-backed implementation slice.

recommendation.title: Owner-sponsor the full plan
recommendation.body: Have Android and Apple owners review, correct, and explicitly sponsor the current document before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The sampled history shows the broadest contribution footprint across the shared Apple package and both mobile Talk surfaces, making @steipete the strongest available routing owner for the cross-platform decision.
